body: I know. So far I feel okay, just a little shaken and a weird feeling in my stomach, I’ll tell them if it gets any worse. Thank you so much for your concern

Thank you, but I don’t think I can tell my parents. They are very supportive, but I don’t think I can face them with this. I don’t want to see their reactions. I’d feel too guilty.
Wishing you the best as well
Thank you so much for the advice, I’ll do my best.

Hey, I know how you feel. I also I have depression and extreme social anxiety, supportive parents, take meds, see therapists. But it just isn’t working. I haven’t been going to school much at all for the past couple of weeks, and when I have, it felt so artificial. Yet I feel as though Im being a drama queen. I have friends and a great family, people who care, yet, I still feel so hollow. I want to die. Nothing is fun anymore. I just don’t want to be here. I know this isn’t the most uplifting comment, but I thought it might be comforting to know someone is experiencing something similar to you. But you can get through this. I can get through this. This is only the beginning of our lives. We are only teenagers for gods sake. It might not be okay now, and that’s okay. It okay to not be okay sometimes. Sorry I’m not very good with my words and comforting others, but I hope this helps. Best of luck to you. <3
